title: The IOU Machine: How Currency Is Created | Hidden Secrets of Money Ep. 4
summary: Episode 4 of Mike Maloney's Hidden Secrets of Money, explaining how currency is created through a chain of IOUs among the Treasury, banks and the Federal Reserve. It covers bonds, Fed checks, debt, taxes and fractional reserve lending, from a gold-and-silver advocate's viewpoint.
why: Recommended, often in Bitcoin and monetary threads, as a clear introduction to how the US money system works, though it comes with a strong goldbug slant.

quote.text: This is the best explanation I've ever seen of how the Fed and US Dollar money printing actually works
